concept: S3 Cross-Region Replication: object copies in another Region
tests: Choosing a mechanism to protect S3 objects from a full Region failure with low RPO.
expected: S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) with versioning on both buckets. Triggers: "survive a full Region outage", "low RPO", "continuously updated copy in a second Region".
why_not: Lifecycle to Glacier stays in the same Region; SRR is within a Region only; EBS snapshots are unrelated to S3.
